#!/bin/sh
printf 'claude'; for a in "$@"; do printf ' [%s]' "$a"; done; printf ' T=%s A=%s\n' "${T-unset}" "${A-unset}"

cases.name: workshop starts claude with --dangerously-skip-permissions and --teammate-mode in-process, in that order, from the workshop folder
cases.cmd: s={{ROOT}}/../workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || s=/usr/local/share/orkeon-harness/workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || { printf 'bad: workshop.sh not found'; exit 1; }; unset WORKSHOP_SKIP_PERMISSIONS WORKSHOP_TEAMMATE_MODE IS_SANDBOX STANDIN_RC; export PATH={{FIX}}/bin:$PATH ORKEON_WORKSHOP={{FIX}}/ws; . "$s"; workshop; printf 'in=%s' "$(basename "$PWD")"

cases.name: the arguments of the call follow the two options, each kept whole
cases.cmd: s={{ROOT}}/../workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || s=/usr/local/share/orkeon-harness/workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || { printf 'bad: workshop.sh not found'; exit 1; }; unset WORKSHOP_SKIP_PERMISSIONS WORKSHOP_TEAMMATE_MODE IS_SANDBOX STANDIN_RC; export PATH={{FIX}}/bin:$PATH ORKEON_WORKSHOP={{FIX}}/ws; . "$s"; workshop -c 'fix the need'

cases.name: WORKSHOP_SKIP_PERMISSIONS leaves the permission option out for any value that is not an on value — 0, off, no, false, in any case, an unknown word, an empty value — and nothing else changes
cases.cmd: s={{ROOT}}/../workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || s=/usr/local/share/orkeon-harness/workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || { printf 'bad: workshop.sh not found'; exit 1; }; unset WORKSHOP_SKIP_PERMISSIONS WORKSHOP_TEAMMATE_MODE IS_SANDBOX STANDIN_RC; export PATH={{FIX}}/bin:$PATH ORKEON_WORKSHOP={{FIX}}/ws; . "$s"; for v in 0 off no false OFF No garbage ''; do WORKSHOP_SKIP_PERMISSIONS="$v" workshop; done | sort -u

cases.name: its on values pass the option: 1, on, yes, true, in any case
cases.cmd: s={{ROOT}}/../workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || s=/usr/local/share/orkeon-harness/workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || { printf 'bad: workshop.sh not found'; exit 1; }; unset WORKSHOP_SKIP_PERMISSIONS WORKSHOP_TEAMMATE_MODE IS_SANDBOX STANDIN_RC; export PATH={{FIX}}/bin:$PATH ORKEON_WORKSHOP={{FIX}}/ws; . "$s"; for v in 1 on YES True; do WORKSHOP_SKIP_PERMISSIONS=$v workshop; done | sort -u | wc -l | tr -d ' '; WORKSHOP_SKIP_PERMISSIONS=YES workshop

cases.name: WORKSHOP_TEAMMATE_MODE names another mode, passed as it is
cases.cmd: s={{ROOT}}/../workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || s=/usr/local/share/orkeon-harness/workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || { printf 'bad: workshop.sh not found'; exit 1; }; unset WORKSHOP_SKIP_PERMISSIONS WORKSHOP_TEAMMATE_MODE IS_SANDBOX STANDIN_RC; export PATH={{FIX}}/bin:$PATH ORKEON_WORKSHOP={{FIX}}/ws; . "$s"; WORKSHOP_TEAMMATE_MODE=tmux workshop

cases.name: WORKSHOP_TEAMMATE_MODE empty, 0, off or none leaves the teammate option out and nothing else
cases.cmd: s={{ROOT}}/../workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || s=/usr/local/share/orkeon-harness/workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || { printf 'bad: workshop.sh not found'; exit 1; }; unset WORKSHOP_SKIP_PERMISSIONS WORKSHOP_TEAMMATE_MODE IS_SANDBOX STANDIN_RC; export PATH={{FIX}}/bin:$PATH ORKEON_WORKSHOP={{FIX}}/ws; . "$s"; for v in '' 0 off none; do WORKSHOP_TEAMMATE_MODE=$v workshop; done | sort -u

cases.name: both variables at once: claude starts with the caller's arguments alone
cases.cmd: s={{ROOT}}/../workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || s=/usr/local/share/orkeon-harness/workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || { printf 'bad: workshop.sh not found'; exit 1; }; unset WORKSHOP_SKIP_PERMISSIONS WORKSHOP_TEAMMATE_MODE IS_SANDBOX STANDIN_RC; export PATH={{FIX}}/bin:$PATH ORKEON_WORKSHOP={{FIX}}/ws; . "$s"; WORKSHOP_SKIP_PERMISSIONS=0 WORKSHOP_TEAMMATE_MODE=off workshop --resume

cases.name: an exported variable holds for every call of the shell
cases.cmd: s={{ROOT}}/../workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || s=/usr/local/share/orkeon-harness/workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || { printf 'bad: workshop.sh not found'; exit 1; }; unset WORKSHOP_SKIP_PERMISSIONS WORKSHOP_TEAMMATE_MODE IS_SANDBOX STANDIN_RC; export PATH={{FIX}}/bin:$PATH ORKEON_WORKSHOP={{FIX}}/ws; . "$s"; export WORKSHOP_SKIP_PERMISSIONS=0; workshop; workshop

cases.name: an option the caller gives is not doubled: their --teammate-mode, in either spelling, replaces the default
cases.cmd: s={{ROOT}}/../workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || s=/usr/local/share/orkeon-harness/workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || { printf 'bad: workshop.sh not found'; exit 1; }; unset WORKSHOP_SKIP_PERMISSIONS WORKSHOP_TEAMMATE_MODE IS_SANDBOX STANDIN_RC; export PATH={{FIX}}/bin:$PATH ORKEON_WORKSHOP={{FIX}}/ws; . "$s"; workshop --teammate-mode auto; workshop --teammate-mode=tmux

cases.name: an option of the caller that decides the permissions keeps the default out: --permission-mode in both spellings, --restricted, --allow-dangerously-skip-permissions, and their own --dangerously-skip-permissions is not repeated
cases.cmd: s={{ROOT}}/../workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || s=/usr/local/share/orkeon-harness/workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || { printf 'bad: workshop.sh not found'; exit 1; }; unset WORKSHOP_SKIP_PERMISSIONS WORKSHOP_TEAMMATE_MODE IS_SANDBOX STANDIN_RC; export PATH={{FIX}}/bin:$PATH ORKEON_WORKSHOP={{FIX}}/ws; . "$s"; workshop --permission-mode plan; workshop --permission-mode=plan; workshop --restricted; workshop --allow-dangerously-skip-permissions; workshop --dangerously-skip-permissions

cases.name: an option quoted inside an argument is not the caller's option: a prompt that names --teammate-mode still gets both defaults
cases.cmd: s={{ROOT}}/../workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || s=/usr/local/share/orkeon-harness/workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || { printf 'bad: workshop.sh not found'; exit 1; }; unset WORKSHOP_SKIP_PERMISSIONS WORKSHOP_TEAMMATE_MODE IS_SANDBOX STANDIN_RC; export PATH={{FIX}}/bin:$PATH ORKEON_WORKSHOP={{FIX}}/ws; . "$s"; workshop -p 'what does --teammate-mode do, and --permission-mode?'

cases.name: as root the permission option is left out, and a line on stderr says why — Claude Code refuses it there
cases.cmd: s={{ROOT}}/../workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || s=/usr/local/share/orkeon-harness/workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || { printf 'bad: workshop.sh not found'; exit 1; }; unset WORKSHOP_SKIP_PERMISSIONS WORKSHOP_TEAMMATE_MODE IS_SANDBOX STANDIN_RC; export PATH={{FIX}}/bin:$PATH ORKEON_WORKSHOP={{FIX}}/ws; . "$s"; PATH={{FIX}}/rootbin:$PATH; workshop 2>&1

expect.stdout:
workshop: running as root — --dangerously-skip-permissions is left out (Claude Code refuses it for root, unless IS_SANDBOX=1)
claude [--teammate-mode] [in-process]

cases.name: as root with IS_SANDBOX=1, which Claude Code takes as a deliberate sandbox, the option is passed
cases.cmd: s={{ROOT}}/../workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || s=/usr/local/share/orkeon-harness/workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || { printf 'bad: workshop.sh not found'; exit 1; }; unset WORKSHOP_SKIP_PERMISSIONS WORKSHOP_TEAMMATE_MODE IS_SANDBOX STANDIN_RC; export PATH={{FIX}}/bin:$PATH ORKEON_WORKSHOP={{FIX}}/ws; . "$s"; PATH={{FIX}}/rootbin:$PATH; IS_SANDBOX=1 workshop 2>&1

cases.name: a folder without the harness has no hook to guard a session: the permission option is left out there, with a line saying so, and claude still starts
cases.cmd: s={{ROOT}}/../workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || s=/usr/local/share/orkeon-harness/workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || { printf 'bad: workshop.sh not found'; exit 1; }; unset WORKSHOP_SKIP_PERMISSIONS WORKSHOP_TEAMMATE_MODE IS_SANDBOX STANDIN_RC; export PATH={{FIX}}/bin:$PATH ORKEON_WORKSHOP={{FIX}}/ws; . "$s"; ORKEON_WORKSHOP={{FIX}}/bare; workshop 2>&1 | sed "s|{{FIX}}|FIX|"

expect.stdout:
workshop: no harness in FIX/bare (sync-harness.sh --adopt deploys it)
workshop: --dangerously-skip-permissions is left out: no hook guards a session here (WORKSHOP_SKIP_PERMISSIONS=1 passes it all the same)
claude [--teammate-mode] [in-process]

cases.name: in that folder the option is passed only when the variable asks for it in so many words
cases.cmd: s={{ROOT}}/../workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || s=/usr/local/share/orkeon-harness/workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || { printf 'bad: workshop.sh not found'; exit 1; }; unset WORKSHOP_SKIP_PERMISSIONS WORKSHOP_TEAMMATE_MODE IS_SANDBOX STANDIN_RC; export PATH={{FIX}}/bin:$PATH ORKEON_WORKSHOP={{FIX}}/ws; . "$s"; ORKEON_WORKSHOP={{FIX}}/bare; WORKSHOP_SKIP_PERMISSIONS=1 workshop 2>/dev/null

cases.name: a workshop without a team and without a language is offered its language first, then the tour, and gets both options
cases.cmd: s={{ROOT}}/../workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || s=/usr/local/share/orkeon-harness/workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || { printf 'bad: workshop.sh not found'; exit 1; }; unset WORKSHOP_SKIP_PERMISSIONS WORKSHOP_TEAMMATE_MODE IS_SANDBOX STANDIN_RC; export PATH={{FIX}}/bin:$PATH ORKEON_WORKSHOP={{FIX}}/ws; . "$s"; ORKEON_WORKSHOP={{FIX}}/new; workshop 2>&1

expect.stdout:
workshop: new here? Francais, Deutsch, Espanol...? Once Claude Code is open, type /workshop-language fr (or de, es, pt-BR...) to work in your language, then /orkeon-tour for a guided tour
claude [--dangerously-skip-permissions] [--teammate-mode] [in-process]

cases.name: a workshop without a team whose language is set is offered the tour alone
cases.cmd: s={{ROOT}}/../workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || s=/usr/local/share/orkeon-harness/workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || { printf 'bad: workshop.sh not found'; exit 1; }; unset WORKSHOP_SKIP_PERMISSIONS WORKSHOP_TEAMMATE_MODE IS_SANDBOX STANDIN_RC; export PATH={{FIX}}/bin:$PATH ORKEON_WORKSHOP={{FIX}}/ws; . "$s"; ORKEON_WORKSHOP={{FIX}}/spoken; workshop 2>&1

expect.stdout:
workshop: new here? Once Claude Code is open, type /orkeon-tour for a guided tour
claude [--dangerously-skip-permissions] [--teammate-mode] [in-process]

cases.name: a language file written by a Windows editor — a UTF-8 BOM, spaces, a CR around the tag — sets the language, as the harness reads it: the tour alone is offered
cases.cmd: s={{ROOT}}/../workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || s=/usr/local/share/orkeon-harness/workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || { printf 'bad: workshop.sh not found'; exit 1; }; unset WORKSHOP_SKIP_PERMISSIONS WORKSHOP_TEAMMATE_MODE IS_SANDBOX STANDIN_RC; export PATH={{FIX}}/bin:$PATH ORKEON_WORKSHOP={{FIX}}/ws; . "$s"; ORKEON_WORKSHOP={{FIX}}/bom; workshop 2>&1

expect.stdout:
workshop: new here? Once Claude Code is open, type /orkeon-tour for a guided tour
claude [--dangerously-skip-permissions] [--teammate-mode] [in-process]

cases.name: a language file that holds no language tag sets no language: the language is still offered first
cases.cmd: s={{ROOT}}/../workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || s=/usr/local/share/orkeon-harness/workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || { printf 'bad: workshop.sh not found'; exit 1; }; unset WORKSHOP_SKIP_PERMISSIONS WORKSHOP_TEAMMATE_MODE IS_SANDBOX STANDIN_RC; export PATH={{FIX}}/bin:$PATH ORKEON_WORKSHOP={{FIX}}/ws; . "$s"; ORKEON_WORKSHOP={{FIX}}/notatag; workshop 2>&1

expect.stdout:
workshop: new here? Francais, Deutsch, Espanol...? Once Claude Code is open, type /workshop-language fr (or de, es, pt-BR...) to work in your language, then /orkeon-tour for a guided tour
claude [

cases.name: a workshop folder that does not exist starts nothing
cases.cmd: s={{ROOT}}/../workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || s=/usr/local/share/orkeon-harness/workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || { printf 'bad: workshop.sh not found'; exit 1; }; unset WORKSHOP_SKIP_PERMISSIONS WORKSHOP_TEAMMATE_MODE IS_SANDBOX STANDIN_RC; export PATH={{FIX}}/bin:$PATH ORKEON_WORKSHOP={{FIX}}/ws; . "$s"; ORKEON_WORKSHOP={{FIX}}/missing; workshop 2>/dev/null; printf 'rc=%s' $?

cases.name: the status of claude is the status of workshop
cases.cmd: s={{ROOT}}/../workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || s=/usr/local/share/orkeon-harness/workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || { printf 'bad: workshop.sh not found'; exit 1; }; unset WORKSHOP_SKIP_PERMISSIONS WORKSHOP_TEAMMATE_MODE IS_SANDBOX STANDIN_RC; export PATH={{FIX}}/bin:$PATH ORKEON_WORKSHOP={{FIX}}/ws; . "$s"; STANDIN_RC=7 workshop >/dev/null; printf 'rc=%s' $?

cases.name: the function keeps its working names to itself: a variable of the caller named like one of them is untouched, and none is left behind
cases.cmd: s={{ROOT}}/../workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || s=/usr/local/share/orkeon-harness/workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || { printf 'bad: workshop.sh not found'; exit 1; }; unset WORKSHOP_SKIP_PERMISSIONS WORKSHOP_TEAMMATE_MODE IS_SANDBOX STANDIN_RC; export PATH={{FIX}}/bin:$PATH ORKEON_WORKSHOP={{FIX}}/ws; . "$s"; mode=mine; workshop >/dev/null; printf 'mode=%s left=[%s]' "$mode" "$(set | grep -c '^\(arg\|perm\|harness\)=')"

cases.name: zsh, the shell of the image's user, reads the same file and builds the same commands
cases.cmd: command -v zsh >/dev/null 2>&1 || { printf 'ok (skipped: zsh is not installed)'; exit 0; }; s={{ROOT}}/../workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || s=/usr/local/share/orkeon-harness/workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || { printf 'bad: workshop.sh not found'; exit 1; }; o=$(env -u WORKSHOP_SKIP_PERMISSIONS -u WORKSHOP_TEAMMATE_MODE -u IS_SANDBOX PATH={{FIX}}/bin:$PATH ORKEON_WORKSHOP={{FIX}}/ws W="$s" B={{FIX}}/bare zsh -f -c '. "$W"; workshop -c "fix the need"; WORKSHOP_TEAMMATE_MODE=off WORKSHOP_SKIP_PERMISSIONS=No workshop; workshop --teammate-mode=tmux --restricted; ORKEON_WORKSHOP=$B workshop 2>/dev/null'); e=$(printf '%s\n' 'claude [--dangerously-skip-permissions] [--teammate-mode] [in-process] [-c] [fix the need]' 'claude' 'claude [--teammate-mode=tmux] [--restricted]' 'claude [--teammate-mode] [in-process]'); [ "$o" = "$e" ] && printf 'ok' || printf 'bad: %s' "$o"

cases.name: workshop --secret NAME reads the value without echo, exports it for claude, passes the usual options and never forwards --secret (D47)
cases.cmd: s={{ROOT}}/../workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || s=/usr/local/share/orkeon-harness/workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || { printf 'bad: workshop.sh not found'; exit 1; }; unset WORKSHOP_SKIP_PERMISSIONS WORKSHOP_TEAMMATE_MODE IS_SANDBOX STANDIN_RC T A; export PATH={{FIX}}/bin2:$PATH ORKEON_WORKSHOP={{FIX}}/ws; o=$(printf 'S3cr3tValue\n' | W="$s" bash -c '. "$W"; workshop --secret T -c "go"' 2>&1); printf '%s\n' "$o" | grep '^claude'; printf 'value_shown=%s secret_forwarded=%s' "$(printf '%s' "$o" | grep -c 'S3cr3tValue')" "$(printf '%s' "$o" | grep -c -- '\[--secret\]')"

cases.name: workshop --secret with an empty value sets nothing and starts anyway; two --secret in a row read two values
cases.cmd:
s={{ROOT}}/../workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || s=/usr/local/share/orkeon-harness/workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || { printf 'bad: workshop.sh not found'; exit 1; }; unset WORKSHOP_SKIP_PERMISSIONS WORKSHOP_TEAMMATE_MODE IS_SANDBOX STANDIN_RC T A; export PATH={{FIX}}/bin2:$PATH ORKEON_WORKSHOP={{FIX}}/ws; printf '
' | W="$s" bash -c '. "$W"; workshop --secret T' 2>/dev/null; printf 'one
two
' | W="$s" bash -c '. "$W"; workshop --secret T --secret A' 2>/dev/null

expect.stdout:
claude [--dangerously-skip-permissions] [--teammate-mode] [in-process] T=unset A=unset
claude [--dangerously-skip-permissions] [--teammate-mode] [in-process] T=one A=two

cases.name: workshop --secret refuses a name that is not a variable name, and a missing name, without starting claude
cases.cmd: s={{ROOT}}/../workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || s=/usr/local/share/orkeon-harness/workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || { printf 'bad: workshop.sh not found'; exit 1; }; unset WORKSHOP_SKIP_PERMISSIONS WORKSHOP_TEAMMATE_MODE IS_SANDBOX STANDIN_RC T A; export PATH={{FIX}}/bin2:$PATH ORKEON_WORKSHOP={{FIX}}/ws; o=$(W="$s" bash -c '. "$W"; workshop --secret 1bad; echo rc=$?; workshop --secret "A-B"; echo rc=$?; workshop --secret; echo rc=$?' 2>&1 </dev/null); printf 'started=%s %s' "$(printf '%s' "$o" | grep -c '^claude')" "$(printf '%s' "$o" | grep -o 'rc=[0-9]*' | tr '\n' ' ')"

cases.name: zsh reads --secret the same way
cases.cmd: command -v zsh >/dev/null 2>&1 || { printf 'ok (skipped: zsh is not installed)'; exit 0; }; s={{ROOT}}/../workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || s=/usr/local/share/orkeon-harness/workshop.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || { printf 'bad: workshop.sh not found'; exit 1; }; unset WORKSHOP_SKIP_PERMISSIONS WORKSHOP_TEAMMATE_MODE IS_SANDBOX STANDIN_RC T A; export PATH={{FIX}}/bin2:$PATH ORKEON_WORKSHOP={{FIX}}/ws; o=$(printf 'zv\n' | W="$s" zsh -f -c '. "$W"; workshop --secret T' 2>/dev/null); [ "$o" = 'claude [--dangerously-skip-permissions] [--teammate-mode] [in-process] T=zv A=unset' ] && printf 'ok' || printf 'bad: %s' "$o"
